propositions: Multiple bundles for a single ref cause git clone to fail with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed' and push to stall in a non-convergent retriable loop because git-remote-s3 rejects any ref operation while bundle count > 1
Upstream git-remote-s3 Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is interactive-only (blocks on input() at EOF) and discards non-chosen bundle heads, losing unique events from the append-only event log

The heal must merge divergent bundle heads losslessly via iterated 2-parent merges (never octopus, following sync._union_merge semantics), write the merged tip as a new bundle before deleting originals, and maintain ≥1 complete bundle at every crash point

The heal acquires the helper's per-ref S3 lock (via acquire_lock/release_lock), re-enumerates bundles under the lock to guard against TOCTOU, fetches each head into local scratch refs, and merges via rebar's write_lock to prevent races with local committers
Content conflicts in non-derived files cause the heal to abort without deleting any remote bundles, release the lock, and surface fsck-recover guidance rather than silently discarding a parent

The heal is invoked from push.py exactly once (healed_once guard) when the multi-bundle stderr signature is detected, then the push is retried; concurrent doctors serialize via the S3 lock so only one merges and others converge on the winner's single healed bundle
